import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    v = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    k = int(next(it))
    v.sort()
    best = 0
    for i in range(n):
        cnt = 1
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if v[j] - v[i] <= k:
                cnt += 1
            else:
                break
        best = max(best, cnt)
    print(best)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
